review_comments_data.body:
Hello @lilitkarapetyan - I think the above bit isn't quite right.  The `name` is optional when submitting feedback, but I think the Game Admin will be interested in both fields. 

Aah, it also highlights another issue.  There isn't a `role` in `messages.details.from`.  This problem is falling through the cracks because this file is `jsx` rather than `tsx`.  Can you convert it to `tsx` please?
Yes, I will work on it now.

Hello @lilitkarapetyan - I want to drop the human-readable `force` and `role` from the `messageDetailsFrom` block.  This is because they can be determined from the `forceId` and `roleId` fields.   It will also mean that if a role-name changes during a wargame, the `from` for old messages will use the new name, rather than the one at the time when the message was sent.

So, this class will have to collate a list of wargames and roles (a dictionary, I guess) and lookup the names of the force and role in order to display them.

review_comments_data.body:
Thanks for double-checking @lilitkarapetyan 

1. I don't think we need `name` since it has moved to `FeedbackMessage`
2. let's drop `forceColor` and `iconURL` - since both can be determined from the wargame data

Oh dear, now we're down to just `forceId` and `roleId`.  We already need `roleId` to be unique across the whole wargame.  So, we could get away with just `roleId`.  If that's the case, we can remove the `MessageDetailsFrom` structure, and just have `from: Role['roleId']` in `MessageDetails`.

That will be quite a big refactoring, but you've done larger recently. 

Does it seem ok with you?
